metadata.case_name: LEUNG KAM SING v. LUEN SHING (PANG FOR) TRANSPORTATION COMPANY AND OTHERS

injuries.description: the Plaintiff's left arm together with part of his shoulder including the clavicle and most of the scapula was avulsed or had to be removed as a result of the accident.
injuries.body_part: left arm and part of left shoulder (including clavicle and most of the scapula)
source: the Plaintiff's left arm together with part of his shoulder including the clavicle and most of the scapula was avulsed or had to be removed as a result of the accident.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation at left shoulder joint

injuries.description: He also sustained an injury to his left ear. I accept his evidence and find that this injury has resulted in very substantial loss of hearing in that ear.
source: He also sustained an injury to his left ear. I accept his evidence and find that this injury has resulted in very substantial loss of hearing in that ear.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of middle or inner ear

manifestations.description: Loss of function of left arm (loss of left arm together with part of shoulder).
Very substantial loss of hearing in the left ear.
Initially suffered severe depression, but condition has since continued to improve.
